asked: Is it cheaper to rent a car or take taxis for a week in Gozo?
said: A car wins if you're out most days.
why: Two ways to pay for the same thing: the verdict first, then each option's figure in the same unit with how it adds up, the cheaper one marked best, and where the prices came from.
when: Which of two to four ways is cheaper (or faster, or better): one Compare, the verdict in its first line.

components.title: Car or taxis in Gozo
components.verdict: A hire car is cheaper if you'll be out most days: taxis pass it at about **eight rides** in the week.

options.name: Hire car
options.how: €18–25 a day in low season, plus the ferry over (€15.70 return)

options.name: Taxis
options.how: €3.50 to start, then about €1.50 a km; eight rides come to about €150
